channel.title: ClawBytes
channel.description: Twice a week, the agents, models, tools and open-source repos worth your time: what shipped, what matters, and where it's all going.

item.title: Labsus
item.description:
Labsus is a browser-based JavaScript workbench for FSAE suspension analysis, covering kinematics, 4-Post dynamics.
https://github.com/ZZzyy714227/Labsus

item.title: SymX
item.description:
SymX is a C++ library for symbolic differentiation that generates, JIT-compiles.
https://github.com/InteractiveComputerGraphics/SymX

item.title: vtkbool
item.description:
Vtkbool adds robust boolean operations on polygonal meshes to the VTK graphics library, making it useful for developers who need reliable mesh intersection.
https://github.com/zippy84/vtkbool

item.title: Einsums in C++
item.description:
Einsums is a C++ MIT-licensed library that performs compile-time contraction pattern analysis to determine optimal tensor operations.
https://github.com/Einsums/Einsums

item.title: 3D Forest
item.description:
3D Forest is a C++ GPL-3.0 application for visualizing, processing, and analyzing terabyte-scale lidar point clouds in forest environments.
https://github.com/VUKOZ-OEL/3d-forest

item.title: Accelerating the search for antimicrobial peptides with Google Antigravity
item.description:

https://deepmind.google/blog/accelerating-antimicrobial-discovery/

item.title: Sotto
item.description:
Syncs secrets end-to-end encrypted so servers only store ciphertext, sharing one Rust crypto implementation between CLI and browser via WebAssembly.
https://github.com/getsotto/sotto

item.title: Sentinel Backend
item.description:
Screens Stellar accounts and monitors Soroban events through a read-only FastAPI service that uses transparent heuristics without holding signing keys.
https://github.com/Stellar-Sentinel/sentinel-backend

item.title: Stellarhyperion Contracts
item.description:

https://github.com/StellarHyperion/stellarhyperion-contracts

Setting only KILO_API_URL keeps routing gateway traffic through that server. • 7.8.10: Add an experimental Search Ignored Paths setting that lists ignored folders or files, such as build output, that the agent's glob tool should still search. • 7.8.10: Keep .gitignore'd files and folders, such as node_modules, out of glob results and grep include searches, even when the pattern m

item.title: OpenClaw 2026.10.5-beta.4
item.description:
• 2026.10.5-beta.4: Updates finish more reliably: macOS updates no longer time out on aliased temporary directories, systemd user installs reclaim abandoned runtimes, pacman and FreeBSD package installs are left to their package manager, snapshot failures are identified before activation with accurate recovery advice, and the success summary no longer repeats settled plugin upgrades as pending. • ChatGPT models work on the default Codex runtime: ChatGPT-listed models no longer fail before sending any request. • Headless browser sign-ins stay usable: headless pages keep accepting clicks and key
https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases/tag/v2026.10.5-beta.4

item.title: Devin CLI v3000.11.92: /goal command and mid-turn steering
item.description:
New `/goal ` command keeps Devin working across turns until it reports the goal complete or blocked — a run pauses itself after 50 turns, not available on prompt-based plans. Steering hands mid-run messages to the running turn instead of the queue; new config.json settings include `agent.subagent_model` and `local_tools_bypass_permissions` (starts local-tools connections with Bypass Permissions on).
https://docs.devin.ai/cli/changelog/stable#updated-13a9d11c
